family.tagline: Two grandparents, a grandson and one Companion Core on a living-room shelf.
family.story: Willem, a retired accountant, keeps the household paperwork at the dining table, and Greet cooks and tends the garden. Their grandson Joris, ten, studies in the guest room. One Companion Core stands on the shelf in the living room.

companion.name: Marmalade
companion.job: Looks up the papers Willem connects and drafts short messages for him.
companion.limits: Looks up and drafts only. Willem reads and sends every message.

companion.name: Parsley
companion.job: Opens web pages in its own browser and fills in the forms Greet lists.
companion.limits: Fills in forms only. Greet checks each one and pays for it herself.

popup.title: A parcel for the shelf
popup.body: On the step of the blue cottage sits a parcel. Willem carries the Companion Core in, and Greet clears the shelf.

popup.title: Unbox the Companion Core
popup.body: Inside: the Companion Core, a power cable, a quick-start guide and a recovery USB drive. Joris lifts out the Core, and Greet holds the guide.

popup.title: Plug it in
popup.body: Joris plugs in the cable, and Willem presses the button. The Core wakes and opens a Wi-Fi network.

popup.title: Join it from a phone
popup.body: Willem opens the Wi-Fi settings on his phone and joins the Core's own network. Then he chooses the home network.

popup.title: Pick the first agents and apps
popup.body: In the Companion Hub store, Willem picks Hermes, Greet picks OpenClaw, and the family adds Paperless-ngx and KitchenOwl. Then they walk away.

beats.capability: an agent that connects to chat apps, email and more from one self-hosted app

popup.title: Marmalade says good morning
popup.body: Willem stands by the shelf and messages the agent he named Marmalade. Marmalade answers from the Core.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: willem
say.text: Good morning, Willem. I am Marmalade.

beats.capability: back up, search and organise your family photos and videos

popup.title: Greet finds the first summer
popup.body: Beside Joris on the sofa, Greet looks back at his first summer. Immich took a while to sort those pictures on the Core, not in a photo cloud.

beats.capability: your files, calendar and contacts on your own Core, synced to your devices

popup.title: A new neighbour joins the contacts
popup.body: On the sofa, Greet types a new neighbour's number into the address book. Nextcloud serves it from the Core to Willem's phone as well as her own.

beats.capability: listen to your audiobooks and podcasts, and pick up where you left off

popup.title: Willem's audiobook resumes mid-chapter
popup.body: On the loveseat in the nook, Willem presses play, and his audiobook resumes where he left it in the garden. Audiobookshelf serves the book from the Core.

beats.capability: listen to your audiobooks and podcasts, and pick up where you left off

popup.title: Joris starts a windmill story
popup.body: On the guest bed, Joris starts the windmill adventure Greet chose for him. Audiobookshelf keeps the book on the Core and saves his place for next time.

beats.capability: translate text and documents on your own Core

popup.title: Joris decodes a honey label
popup.body: The honey jar a neighbour brought back from her trip has a label Joris cannot read. He types it into LibreTranslate, which translates on the Core with models downloaded once.

beats.capability: the Obsidian note app in your browser; notes stay as local Markdown files

popup.title: Joris types up his bee project
popup.body: Under the wall hanging, Joris types his bee project into Obsidian, one fact to a line. The notes are plain Markdown files on the Core.

beats.capability: a shared grocery list, recipe book, meal planner and expense tracker for the household

popup.title: Greet plans an apple cake
popup.body: A bowl of windfall apples sits by the sink. At the breakfast bar, Greet adds apple cake to the week's plan in KitchenOwl, and the flour joins the list.

beats.capability: send a push notification to your phone from any script or automation

popup.title: The loaf calls Greet indoors
popup.body: With the loaf in the oven, Greet heads out to the beds. A timer Willem set on the Core sends her phone a ntfy note when the loaf is done.

beats.capability: a family planner with a shared calendar, tasks, shopping, meals

popup.title: Greet adds the harvest assembly
popup.body: Beside the fridge, Greet adds Friday's harvest assembly to Yuvomi, the house's one calendar. Willem sees it too, since Yuvomi keeps one shared calendar in a database on the Core.

beats.capability: scan and file your paperwork; it reads every page, tags it and makes it searchable

popup.title: Willem tips out the biscuit tin
popup.body: A biscuit tin of receipts comes out onto the table. Willem scans them into Paperless-ngx on the Core, not a rented drive, and one search finds the boiler bill.

beats.capability: store every password in a vault you host

popup.title: Greet finds the Wi-Fi password
popup.body: A visiting aunt asks for the Wi-Fi password, and Greet finds it in VaultWarden. The vault runs on the Core and works with the Bitwarden apps.

beats.capability: keeps your digital life on your own disk, so your agents know your context

popup.title: Marmalade finds the service date
popup.body: Willem asks Marmalade when the oven was last serviced. Marmalade answers from the service letters Willem connected to Companion Memory (beta); Willem checks the date himself.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

beats.capability: budget around recurring expenses by setting money aside for upcoming bills and goals

popup.title: Willem saves for spring's bill
popup.body: The house insurance falls due in spring, so Willem sets money aside each month in monetr. He types the figures himself, and no bank is linked.

beats.capability: an agent with its own browser that fills in web forms

popup.title: Sweet peas go in the basket
popup.body: On the deck, Greet lists the sweet peas and beans she wants. Parsley fills a seed basket in its own browser; Greet checks it and pays for it herself.
popup.note: OpenClaw reaches websites over your home internet.

beats.capability: track your plants, watering and care history across rooms and beds

popup.title: Joris pots a rosemary cutting
popup.body: On Saturday morning, Joris pots a rosemary cutting in the deck planter and photographs it for HortusFox. Greet adds a care note, and the journal sits on the Core.

beats.capability: an agent that connects to chat apps, email and more from one self-hosted app

popup.title: Willem sends the pool note himself
popup.body: By the pool, Willem asks Marmalade to draft a note to the pool service about the autumn cover. Willem reads it and sends it himself.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

popup.title: Three people share one shelf
popup.body: The loaf cools, the bee notes are written and the receipts are filed, on one shared Core.

closing.body: Your paperwork, pictures and recipes can live on a Companion Core at home. Browse the Companion Hub store and pick your first apps.

notes: No TV and no desk in this home: the media beats sit on the couch (Immich, Nextcloud contacts, Audiobookshelf), and Willem works at the dining table. The guest bedroom has a bed, a wall hanging and a chest, no desk.
Joris has no companion and no agent chat: his beats are Audiobookshelf, LibreTranslate and Obsidian only. The tablet is never named; Joris is simply on the bed.
Companion Memory (beta) is first named in dining-service, a film beat; ftue-pick does not name it. Marmalade is Hermes with memory true; the chat-service note rides on every Hermes beat.
garden-seeds: Parsley (OpenClaw) fills a basket, Greet checks and pays for it herself; carries the OpenClaw website note; no key or model is mentioned.
monetr: Willem types the figures himself, no bank link, no advice. Immich beat carries the slow first start. Crash reports are not mentioned; no beat says nothing leaves the Core.

ntfy (kitchen-loaf) is a Core timer Willem set, sent to Greet's phone, no iOS relay claim. The exact tail sits on the Core, not in a rented X is used once (dining-receipts); the photo cloud line once.

joris-windmill: Audiobookshelf, replaces Audible only. Willem's living-audio beat resumes a book; Joris's starts a new one. The family's own audiobook files, one place kept per book, nothing about podcasts or accounts.
